about.en: BORA is the token of the BORA blockchain entertainment and gaming ecosystem run by Metabora, a Kakao Games affiliate in South Korea. It is the KIP-7 token at 0x02cbe46fb8a1f579254a9b485788f2d86cad51aa on Kaia (formerly Klaytn) and is used for in-game rewards, fees and governance across BORA's games and services.
